_about: Mohamed Salah's penalty after 24 seconds' play (2nd minute), Tottenham Hotspur 0-2 Liverpool, Champions League final, Estadio Metropolitano, Madrid, 1 June 2019. Moussa Sissoko was penalised for handball; Salah shot to the right (Wikipedia); Hugo Lloris in goal. Sources: Wikipedia 2019 UCL final, FIFA 'Liverpool sink Spurs for sixth European crown'. Tottenham were the designated home side. Kits: Liverpool red, Spurs white shirts, navy shorts (both home kits; socks assumed). Keeper kits assumed.
